coaching.headline: A clean win that leaked four majors: both enemy Mini Primes and the Genesis Core at 24 fell with Argus or Skylar dead, and the Genesis Core at 17 went uncontested with all five of us alive.
coaching.team: We won on structures and objective damage: 8 towers to 3, and 70,194 objective damage to their 19,550. The early game was messier than the score. Skylar took first blood on Grux at 2.4, then donated three solo deaths to Grux before 10.3. Argus was caught alone by The Fey at 9.6. The river went 16 to 8 their way; both their Mini Primes and the Genesis Core at 24 fell with one of us already dead, and the Genesis Core at 17 went uncontested with all five of us alive. The fight at 8.3, lost 1-3 at our Fangtooth, was a trade: we had just taken the Fangtooth. From 20.1 on nothing was close: won 4-0 at our Fangtooth, then fights won 3-2, 3-1 and 3-1, each followed by a tower. Primal Fangtooth at 26 and Orb Prime at 27 closed it. Nine fights won, six cashed. Vision was ours, 36 wards to 23. Next game: no solo deaths before minute 10 in the offlane or mid. Argus at 9.6 and Skylar at 10.3 were the two that mattered. Mini Prime at 11 was the price.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The fight at 20.1, won 4-0 at our Fangtooth, was the turn: Fangtooth fell to us at 20.3 and two outer towers followed inside two minutes. From there every fight was won and the towers kept falling.
coaching.whatWorked: Scarlett's jungle: 34,342 objective damage, the most on either team, and the 2-0 pick on Bayle and GRIM.exe at 11.1 at their Mini Prime.

One death, at 8.4 inside the lost fight at our Fangtooth, not a solo catch. Four of the five kills came after 26, when the game was already won.

The 2-0 pick at 11.1 on Bayle and GRIM.exe was traded for their Mini Prime, the right trade when their carry and support die for it. Two deaths, neither solo. No armor against three physical damage dealers.

First blood on Grux at 2.4, a second kill before minute 5, then three solo deaths to Grux before 10.3, their Mini Prime taken while she was dead. Seven kills say the hero was fine; the three solo deaths were the leak.

Caught alone by The Fey at 9.6 and by GRIM.exe at 16.3; three enemy majors and three towers fell with Argus dead first. 3 wards, fewest on the team.

20.1.call: Won 4-0 at our Fangtooth, then Fangtooth at 20.3 and two outer towers by minute 22. This is the template: fight on top of our own objective, then take the structures the fight opens.

24.1.call: Won 3-1, yet gave up the Genesis Core at 24 and an inner tower at 24.7 with Argus dead. After winning a fight a body down, clear the jungle objective first; Primal Fangtooth at 26 was the right follow-up.

26.1.call: Fought 3-1 at their inhibitor two items down, 9 to 11, and won it; the inhibitor fell right after and Orb Prime at 27. The call was right: Primal Fangtooth was already ours, so pushing with it was the win.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Off the core (no Crescelia, Enra's Blessing or Windcaller) and it did not cost a fight after 8.4: Hexbound Bracers, Gaia Greaves and Everbloom bought health and heal power, and the only lost fight was the one where Boris caught Scarlett and Maco at our Fangtooth. Nothing else to teach.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Maco.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Tainted Rounds and Ruination instead of Solaris and Ashbringer bought anti-heal and burst over cooldown refunds; against a lineup with no healer the anti-heal slot was spare, and 35,468 damage on one death says the game never tested it.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit into Grux and Boris, and trades away the burst an item-scaling Demiurge would give.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No armor against three physical damage dealers (Manta Scythe, Malady, Earthshaker, Infernum), and two deaths, both to Boris and Grux inside fights, so the game never punished it.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex marks whoever Scarlett last hit for more damage dealt and less taken, a duelist fit for a jungler who picks one target deep in the enemy jungle, and gives up the raw health Krix would bring.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: The three solo deaths to Grux came before the first item was online (Vanquisher, estimated minute 12), so the build had no part in them; the rest of her 7 kills came on Vanquisher, Deathstalker, Tainted Rounds and Terminus, off the Plasma Blade and Imperator half of the core.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On the Azure Core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings core with Overseer fourth; nothing to teach here.

loadout.name: Ferocious Flight
loadout.text: For each Enemy hit by Maco Fly, Maco gains 20/40/60/80/100 (+15%)(+1%) additional Shielding and the ability's Cooldown is reduced by 1.5s. This effect also occurs on non-Heroes, but is reduced by 80%.

ability.name: Purge
